name: Collect rainwater
summary: Any roof or tarp turns rain into stored water: every millimetre of rain on a square metre gives about a litre. Run gutters or a sloped tarp into a covered tank, and send the first dirty flush to waste. Treat the water before drinking.

parts.why: Holds the water; keep it covered and screened
Catchment where there’s no roof, and covers for tanks
Bends into gutters, or makes a catchment roof

tips: A 50 m² roof in a 10 mm shower gives about 400–500 litres.
Screen inlets and keep tanks covered: mosquitoes breed in open water within a week.
Let the first few minutes of rain wash the roof and run to waste before you collect.
Roof water carries bird droppings and dust. Filter and disinfect it before drinking.
